# ultramotion

> Open-source motion graphics templates for AI coding agents (Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex and other agents that load Agent Skills). Ask your agent for a video and it builds a finished vertical (9:16) motion graphics video with music from a template — no After Effects, no Remotion project, no editing skills. MIT licensed.

Install: `npx skills add sunsiyuan/ultramotion`

How it works: each style is an Agent Skill. `scene.html` draws every frame in code (the frame is a pure function of time), `score.py` generates the soundtrack with numpy/scipy, and the agent renders the frames to mp4 with a headless browser and ffmpeg, then muxes the music.

## Styles

- [Liquid Glass](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/liquid-glass/): Apple-style glass that pops, stretches, merges and bends the text behind it, on a soft gradient, cut to a beat. (9:16, 120 BPM)
- [Kinetic Type](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/kinetic-type/): Heavy condensed type slamming in on the beat, with full-frame colour-block cuts — for gig promos, quotes and countdowns. (9:16, 128 BPM)
- [Variety Captions](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/variety-captions/): Variety-show captions on your own footage: pop words, bursts, stamps, subtitles and sound effects, placed around the face. (On your footage)
- [Hand-drawn Explainer](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/whiteboard/): Whiteboard, notebook or chalkboard explainers, written stroke by stroke as the camera moves across the board, with its own music. (9:16, written stroke by stroke)
- [Light Particles](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/light-particles/): Hundreds of thousands of glowing particles that gather into products, vehicles, towns and titles, build up in order and light up — for reveals, launches and greetings. (9:16, up to 1.6M particles)
- [Flat Explainer](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/flat-explainer/): Kurzgesagt-style narrated explainers: the voice-over is timed word by word, things pop in as they are named, the camera travels across scales, flat shapes with soft three-tone shading. (9:16, narrated)
- [Painterly](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/painterly/): A living oil painting in the manner of Van Gogh and Loving Vincent: thick brush strokes that follow the form, a sky that turns, impasto catching the light, the camera walking into the picture. (9:16, oil paint that moves)
- [Ink Wash](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/ink-wash/): Chinese ink painting in the manner of the Shanghai Animation Film Studio: ink creeps across rice paper, the painting keeps living — rain, mist, a boat, a school of tadpoles — scenes dissolve through the ink, a seal at the end. (9:16, ink that spreads and lives)
- [Event Replay](https://ultramotion.ai/styles/event-replay/): A moment in history replayed from real data, in the manner of Neil Halloran and the New York Times: start from the whole and narrow to the moment, a clock that stretches the decisive minutes, a line that carries time, maps on real relief, numbers turned into things you can count. (9:16 or 16:9, real data)

## Guides

- [Claude Motion: what it does, who can use it, and an open-source option](https://ultramotion.ai/claude-motion/): Claude Motion turns a prompt into an animation you export as MP4, in beta on Team and Enterprise plans. What it does, who gets it, and how ultramotion does the same thing in Claude Code on any plan.
- [An After Effects alternative for people who just need the video](https://ultramotion.ai/after-effects-alternative/): Make motion graphics without learning After Effects: describe the video to Claude Code or ChatGPT Codex and an open-source motion template renders it to mp4 with music.
- [Remotion for beginners — or skip the React setup](https://ultramotion.ai/remotion-alternative/): Want programmatic video like Remotion without learning React and a video framework first? ultramotion templates let your AI agent write, render and score the video for you.
